verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਗਾਵੈ ਜਾਈ ਜਾਗਤ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਜਾਹਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਨ ਬੁਲਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: joiee prabh bhaavai taeh sovat jagaavai jaiee jaagat bihaavai jaeh taeh na bulaaviee ||

en.bdb: A woman-like seeker whom He likes, Lord goes and wakes her up. But one who spends the night awake, He does not go and talk to her.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਮਾਨਨਿ ਮਨਾਵੈ ਧਾਇ  ਸੇਵਕ ਸ੍ਵਰੂਪ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਤ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: joiee prabh bhaavai taeh maanan manaavai dhai  sevak savairoop sevaa karat na bhaaviee ||

en.bdb: The seeker woman who is liked by Him, and even if she is proud and arrogant, He rushes to please her and bring her around. On the other hand, a seeker woman may be seen doing service outwardly, she may not be liked by Him even then.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਰੀਝ ਕੈ ਰੀਝਾਵੈ ਆਪਾ  ਕਾਛਿ ਕਾਛਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਪਗ ਨ ਲਗਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: joiee prabh bhaavai taeh reejh kai reejhaavai aapaa  kaachh kaachh aavai taeh pag na lagaaviee ||

en.bdb: The seeker woman whom Lord likes and becomes kind upon her, He pleases her but one who adorns herself and come to Him with ego-filled mind, He does not even let her touch His feet.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਸਬੈ ਬਨਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾ ਕੀ  ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਪਾਰ ਨ ਕਹਤ ਬਨਿ ਆਵਈ ॥੫੯੪॥
verses.translit_en: joiee prabh bhaavai taeh sabai ban aavai taa kee  mahimaa apaar na kahat ban aaviee ||594||

en.bdb: A seeker woman whom He likes, all efforts and labour bear fruit. Her grandeur is beyond and difficult to express.  (594)
